name: misteriobox
description: MistérioBox — plataforma Web de investigação interativa (API REST + site Web).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w backend && npm run lint:fix -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
